title: appstore-release config
description: Per-app App Store listing content. Credentials are NOT here — they come from the environment (ASC_KEY_ID, ASC_ISSUER_ID, ASC_P8_PATH or ASC_P8) and the numeric app id from ASC_APP_ID. Relative paths resolve against this file's directory.

bundleId.description: Reverse-DNS bundle identifier, as registered with Apple. Required by the credentials operation.

locale.description: The App Store locale this config's content is written in, e.g. en-US or tr.

locales.description: Additional App Store locales, keyed by locale code. Each entry overrides config.metadata for that locale; anything it omits is inherited. Omit this block entirely for a single-locale app.

metadata.description: The listing for config.locale, and the default for every entry in config.locales. Fields shared across locales belong here so they are written once.

primary.description: App Store category id, e.g. LIFESTYLE or PRODUCTIVITY.

ageRating.description: The age-rating declaration. Every key defaults to NONE or false, and the complete set is always sent — Apple returns 409 for a partial one. Omit this block for a 4+ app.

alcoholTobaccoOrDrugUseOrReferences.description: How much of this the app contains. Defaults to NONE.

contests.description: How much of this the app contains. Defaults to NONE.

gamblingSimulated.description: How much of this the app contains. Defaults to NONE.

gunsOrOtherWeapons.description: How much of this the app contains. Defaults to NONE.

horrorOrFearThemes.description: How much of this the app contains. Defaults to NONE.

matureOrSuggestiveThemes.description: How much of this the app contains. Defaults to NONE.

medicalOrTreatmentInformation.description: How much of this the app contains. Defaults to NONE.

profanityOrCrudeHumor.description: How much of this the app contains. Defaults to NONE.

sexualContentGraphicAndNudity.description: How much of this the app contains. Defaults to NONE.

sexualContentOrNudity.description: How much of this the app contains. Defaults to NONE.

violenceCartoonOrFantasy.description: How much of this the app contains. Defaults to NONE.

violenceRealistic.description: How much of this the app contains. Defaults to NONE.

violenceRealisticProlongedGraphicOrSadis.description: How much of this the app contains. Defaults to NONE.

ageAssurance.description: Defaults to false. Required by Apple — sent as false when unset.

kidsAgeBand.description: Only for apps in the Kids category.

ageRating4Plus.description: Deprecated: set `ageRating` instead. `false` still means 'leave the declaration alone'.

contentRights.description: Third-party content declaration, required before review.

price.description: Either the string "free", or an amount and the territory it is quoted in. Apple takes a price point rather than an amount, so the nearest one is used.

baseTerritory.description: Territory the amount is quoted in. Defaults to USA.

review.description: What App Review needs in order to reach a human and to sign in.

releaseType.description: Not implemented yet — declared here but not written to App Store Connect.

screenshots.description: Where the store screenshots live. Use `dir` alone for one device size, or `sets` for several. In either case a subdirectory named after a locale (./shots/tr/) overrides the base directory for that locale.

displayType.description: The single device size, when `sets` is not used. APP_IPHONE_67 is 1290×2796 and covers both 6.7" and 6.9" — there is no APP_IPHONE_69.

dir.description: Directory of exact-size PNGs, relative to this config file. Filename order is display order, and it must contain nothing but store screenshots.

sets.description: One entry per device size. Required when the app supports iPad: Apple will not accept a tablet-capable build with no iPad screenshots.

dir.description: Directory for this device size. Defaults to screenshots.dir.

outputDir.description: Where the credentials operation writes the .p12, the provisioning profile and credentials.json. Git-ignore it: these are secrets.

subscription.description: Omit this whole block if the app has no subscription.

productId.description: The subscription's product id, as created in App Store Connect.

groupDisplayName.description: Customer-visible name of the subscription group.

priceTerritory.description: Base territory for the price, e.g. USA.

priceAmount.description: Target price; the nearest Apple price point is used.

reviewScreenshot.description: Path to a paywall screenshot, relative to this config. Without it the subscription stays MISSING_METADATA.

listing.description: The textual listing for one App Store locale. Apple splits these across two resources; this tool routes each field to the right one.

name.description: App name as shown on the App Store.

description.description: Full description. No emoji — App Store Connect rejects them with 409 ATTRIBUTE.INVALID.INVALID_CHARACTERS. Bullets and em dashes are fine.

keywords.description: Comma-separated, 100 characters total including the commas.

copyright.description: Required, even for a free app; without it App Store Connect refuses 'Add for Review'.

whatsNew.description: Release notes. ONLY for updates — setting it on a first version returns 409 STATE_ERROR.

listing.title: Localized listing
